market.what: Co/Ni separation circuit (Cyanex 272/P507 SX) in black-mass hydromet, world
market.method: ~30% of ~$440M separation spend (Co ~60 kg/t BM, many scrub stages for Co/Ni). bottom-up est.: ~600 kt Ni/Co black mass refined (120 kt Ni at ~20% Ni) x ~$735/t separation cost [opex ~$340/t: NaOH saponification ~440 kg x $368/t, strip acid ~540 kg x $123/t, Na2SO4 handling, organic loss; capex charge ~$395/t: 35% SX share x 15%/yr of ~$5k/t-yr Asia or ~$26k/t-yr West (Li-Cycle $0.85-1B/35 kt)]

value.logic: Co-over-Ni binder cuts Co circuit cost 40% = $52M + 0.5% more Co/Ni of ~$2.8B = $14M
value.revenue_logic: $65M x 2.66 (2032 volumes) x 6% adoption x 35% capture

trend.drivers: recycled Co 30 kt (2024) -> 121 kt (2034); DRC export quotas tripled Co prices in 2025; low-Co cathodes cap Co per tonne
trend.deadline: EU Battery Reg: 90% Co recovery by 31 Dec 2027; 16% recycled Co in new batteries from 2031

competition.notes: Cyanex 272 is the benchmark (high Co/Ni factor, needs NaOH saponification); solid Cyanex-272 sorbents (<2% Ni co-uptake) are academic rivals

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom Co ligand, grafted on silica/resin (3 variants)
lab.test: Co/Ni separation factor vs pH in real NMC leach, isotherms, column + strip, ICP-OES; university hydromet lab
lab.logic: ligand 6 wk $15-20k + grafting 4 wk $10-15k; test 6 wk ~300 ICP-OES x $40-50 + leach/columns ~$10k

sale.gates: bench on real leach 3-6 mo; recycler pilot 6-12 mo; CoSO4 offtaker qualification 6-12 mo
